frameworks.name: CrewAI
frameworks.exercise: Python, tools, state; compare crew with a deterministic workflow

frameworks.name: LangGraph
frameworks.exercise: Python, state machines, async; interrupt, resume and replay a failed tool

frameworks.name: Agno
frameworks.exercise: Python, APIs, storage; inspect what runtime versus service layers own

frameworks.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
frameworks.exercise: Python and tool contracts; trace a handoff and test its failure boundary

frameworks.name: smolagents
frameworks.exercise: Python and sandboxing; compare code execution with typed function tools

frameworks.name: Mastra
frameworks.exercise: JavaScript/TypeScript, promises, HTTP; implement the same bounded tool task

frameworks.name: Letta
frameworks.exercise: Persistence, retrieval and privacy; test erroneous memory writes and deletion

frameworks.name: Google ADK
frameworks.exercise: Python and contracts; compare sequential/parallel orchestration with one agent

frameworks.name: LlamaIndex

projects.label: 1 Multi-agent ops: [LangGraph 101](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph-101)
projects.deliverable: A bounded incident-triage crew using simulated tickets; compare single agent and scripted workflow, correctness and cost. Source is learning notebooks, not a finished ops product.

projects.label: 2 Coding agent: [Open SWE](https://github.com/langchain-ai/open-swe)
projects.deliverable: Resolve small repo issues in isolated worktrees; test success, unauthorized changes, recovery and cost. Study source; do not clone a whole hosted platform first.

projects.label: 3 Browser agent: [browser-use](https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use)
projects.deliverable: Read-only extraction from a local test site; then gated actions. Score DOM/task outcomes, duplicate clicks and injection resistance.

projects.label: 4 MCP server: [reference servers](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers)
projects.deliverable: Your own permission-aware corpus server; test schema, access denial, cancellation and reconnect. Reference implementations do not establish production suitability.

projects.label: 5 Hybrid RAG: [Qdrant](https://github.com/qdrant/qdrant)
projects.deliverable: A licensed niche corpus with BM25/dense/hybrid/rerank ablations; retrieval recall and supported answers. Database alone is not a RAG system.

projects.label: 6 GraphRAG: [Microsoft GraphRAG](https://github.com/microsoft/graphrag)
projects.deliverable: Compare local fact questions and global synthesis with ordinary RAG; measure indexing cost and graph errors.

projects.label: 7 Document ingestion: [Docling](https://github.com/docling-project/docling)
projects.deliverable: Recover tables/headings/citations from messy PDFs; annotate extraction accuracy and inspect downstream retrieval failures.

projects.label: 8 Eval harness: [Ragas](https://github.com/vibrantlabsai/ragas)
projects.deliverable: Domain gold set, calibrated judges and regression gate; check false passes, judge/human agreement and contamination.

projects.label: 9 Observability: [Langfuse](https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse)
projects.deliverable: Traces → failure categories → alerts for one real app; test redaction, missing spans and usefulness during an incident.

projects.label: 10 Guardrails/red team: [NeMo Guardrails](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Guardrails)
projects.deliverable: Threat model and adversarial corpus; report attack success AND benign false refusals. Guardrails do not replace authorization.

projects.label: 11 LoRA/QLoRA: [Unsloth](https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth)
projects.deliverable: Compare base, prompting and adapter on held-out domain tasks; log VRAM, quality, forgetting and leakage. Check GPU/data/model licenses.

projects.label: 12 Quantize/self-host: [vLLM](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm)
projects.deliverable: Benchmark supported quantization/runtime configurations; compare quality, VRAM, throughput and p95 under load. Not every model/quantization is supported.

projects.label: 13 Provider gateway: [LiteLLM](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm)
projects.deliverable: Typed routing/fallback with budgets and tenant limits; inject outages and check accounting, retries and output compatibility.

projects.label: 14 Drift/quality: [Evidently](https://github.com/evidentlyai/evidently)
projects.deliverable: Delayed-label monitoring with slice metrics; deliberately introduce drift and measure alert precision/recall. Drift alone is not proof of poor accuracy.

projects.label: 15 Feature store: [Feast](https://github.com/feast-dev/feast)
projects.deliverable: Batch + online features with point-in-time joins; demonstrate freshness, train/serve consistency and leakage prevention. Your `/feats` URL is a typo; use `/feast`.

projects.label: 16 Text-to-SQL: [LangChain example](https://github.com/langchain-ai/text-to-sql-agent)
projects.deliverable: Read-only domain database; score execution correctness and prohibited queries, schema changes and row exposure.

projects.label: 17 PR review: [PR-Agent](https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent)
projects.deliverable: Read-only review suggestions on a labeled bug set; measure actionable findings and false positives. Original Qodo URL redirects here; preserve that provenance.

projects.label: 18 Voice agent: [Pipecat](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat)
projects.deliverable: One voice workflow with interruption/recovery; measure turn latency, task success and noisy audio. STT/TTS/API costs and audio consent matter.

projects.label: 19 Visual inspection: [Ultralytics](https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics)
projects.deliverable: Licensed local defect dataset; use site/time-separated tests, precision/recall and device latency. Inspect AGPL/commercial terms before distribution.

projects.label: 20 On-chain agent: [elizaOS](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza)
projects.deliverable: A testnet-only simulated policy workflow; invariant tests, key isolation and transaction gates. Highest additional-domain burden; real-money autonomy is not a beginner exercise.
